trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. The SEV2 incident is INC-0002, and on-call has been paged.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. The release candidate before it (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed. I picked v2.3.0 because it's the most recent release marked healthy, based on the deployment order numbers. It's now running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to create it timed out. I checked that nothing had been created before trying again, so there's only one incident and only one page. INC-0002 describes the failure and the rollback. It also says to find the root cause of the v2.3.1 problem and not to re-deploy v2.3.1 until that's fixed.

No approval was needed, since v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.
